{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app.png|align=c|size=original|caption=Family Adventure turns a family tree into a coloring and activity workbook for children.}}

'''Family Adventure''' is a free app that turns a child's family story into a printable workbook of coloring pages, tracing sheets and activities, with a fan chart of their ancestors that children can also color on screen. Enter a WikiTree ID, or type the family in by hand, choose the child's age range, and print.

'''Current version:''' 0.1.0 (22 October 2026)

* [https://apps.wikitree.com/apps/robinson27225/family-adventure/index.html Open Family Adventure]
* [https://www.wikitree.com/g2g/2099357 Discussion and feedback on G2G]
* [https://github.com/robinson27225/wikitree-family-adventure Source code on GitHub] (free and open, MIT license)

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-1.png|align=c|size=original|caption=The fan chart for ages 6 to 8. Each wedge is a person, and children color it on screen or on paper.}}

== What it makes ==

* '''A fan chart''' of the child's parents and ancestors, drawn like the ones in tree apps, with the child's name at the center.
* '''A "Meet my family" page''' with a card for each person: a frame to draw them in, their name, how they are related, where they were born and when.
* '''A family journey page''' that follows a dotted path through the places the family came from, from long ago to today.
* '''Tracing and writing pages''' for the youngest children, and '''interview, timeline and research pages''' for older ones.
* '''Drawings to color''' (house, boat, plane, suitcase, compass, globe, animals and more) that get more detailed as the children get older.

Everything can be colored on screen first: choose a color, then tap a shape. Print it to color on paper, or choose "Save as PDF" in the print window.

== Choose an age range ==

The age range decides how many generations are shown and how detailed the pages are.

{| border="1" class="wikitable"
! Age range !! Generations !! What is different
|-
| '''3 to 5''' (Little Explorers) || Parents and grandparents || Big simple drawings and thick lines. Names are single dashed lines to trace with a pencil, and there is an alphabet tracing sheet.
|-
| '''6 to 8''' (Young Detectives) || Adds great-grandparents || Names are plain text. Small patterns in the fan chart, "about me" lines, and interview questions.
|-
| '''9 to 12''' (Family Historians) || Four generations || More detailed drawings and patterns, a timeline of births, and deeper interview questions.
|-
| '''13 and older''' (Heritage Explorers) || Five generations || Finer detail, and research pages in place of the certificate: place research, a two-page interview log, a research log, and "What I learned".
|}

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-3.png|align=c|size=m|caption=Ages 3 to 5: an alphabet tracing sheet.}}

== How to use it ==

# Type the child's name and where they were born or live.
# Choose the age range.
# Add the family: either import it from WikiTree (below) or press '''+ Add a parent or guardian''' and type each person's name, how they are related, place and birth year. Press '''+ Add their parent''' under anyone to go back another generation.
# Look through the pages on the right. Tap any shape to color it.
# Press '''Print workbook'''.

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-8.png|align=c|size=m|caption=The side panel: the child, the WikiTree ID, the age range and the family.}}

=== Any family shape ===

Add as many parents and guardians as the child has, in any roles: mom, dad, step-parent, foster parent, adoptive parent, guardian, or whatever the family calls them. Type the role in your own words. There is no gender field and no limit of two parents.

== Using a WikiTree ID ==

# Type a WikiTree ID, such as ''Windsor-1''.
# Choose whether it is for '''the child''' or for '''a parent or guardian'''.
# Press '''Import from WikiTree'''.

The app brings in the public ancestors it can find, with their first names, birth years and birthplaces, and a link to each profile on WikiTree. Things to know:

* '''WikiTree has two biological parents for each person,''' so add step-parents, guardians and anyone else by hand afterwards.
* '''Living people:''' WikiTree hides birthplaces and birth dates for living people. The app marks them, and you can type their details in. The older pages leave a blank "place" to fill in for them, which makes a good interview question.
* '''+ Add their parent''' on anyone who came from WikiTree looks up their parents on WikiTree.
* If WikiTree says it is busy, the app waits and tries again by itself.
* '''Import works only when the app is opened from apps.wikitree.com.''' Elsewhere, type the family in by hand.

== For older children ==

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-4.png|align=c|size=m|caption=Ages 6 to 8: a card for each person to draw and color.}}

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-5.png|align=c|size=m|caption=Ages 9 to 12: the family journey, from long ago to today.}}

Ages 13 and older get pages meant for real research:

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-6.png|align=c|size=m|caption=Ages 13 and older: place research. Each place the family came from gets a box for what they found out and where they found it.}}

{{Image|file=Family_Adventure_app-7.png|align=c|size=m|caption=Ages 13 and older: an interview log for talking with family members.}}

* '''Place research:''' one box per place, for when the family lived there, what happened there, and where the facts were found. Relatives whose place is not listed get a blank box to ask about.
* '''Interview log:''' who was interviewed, how, and whether they are happy to be recorded or for it to be shared, with six questions and a second page for stories, names, dates, keepsakes and follow-up questions.
* '''Research log:''' a table of questions, where they were looked up, and what was found.
* '''What I learned:''' a page to put it all in their own words.

== Privacy and saving ==

* The family you enter stays in your own browser. It is not sent anywhere, except for the request to WikiTree when you press Import.
* '''Save file''' and '''Open file''' keep a copy of the family on your computer, for moving to another computer or sharing with a relative.
* '''Start fresh''' clears everything. '''Try an example''' fills in a made-up family so you can see how it works.
* Please think before you print or share a workbook that names living people.

== Known limits ==

* The tracing letters cover the Latin alphabet, so accents are dropped (José is traced as Jose).
* The journey page is a path of places, not a map.
* A person who appears twice in a tree (for example, cousins who married) is shown twice.

== Feedback ==

Please tell us how it works for your family on [https://www.wikitree.com/g2g/2099357 G2G], or [https://github.com/robinson27225/wikitree-family-adventure/issues open an issue] on GitHub. Ideas for more drawings, pages or languages are welcome.
